sentence: This project builds software and web tools that let community members browse and search data in a database, including tools that use machine learning.
This project studies how basic processes in the nucleus of a cell go wrong in cancer cells, including gene dysregulation and DNA damage.
This project collects and stores biospecimen samples and studies fluid biomarkers and genetics to help understand Alzheimer's disease and related dementias.
This project provides light and electron microscopy tools to study the structure and behavior of cells and tissues in cancer research.
This project studies the high resolution structure of a membrane transporter protein and how physical and chemical stimuli regulate it.
This project tries to find out which cellular and molecular mechanisms go wrong in neurodevelopmental disorders.
This project tries to find out how immune responses differ between people who recover from Lyme disease and people who have persistent symptoms.
This project builds a high-speed x-ray camera system that images blood flow in the arteries during x-ray image-guided procedures.
This project looks for small molecules that block a protein and studies how that protein contributes to cancer progression.
This project studies suicidal thoughts and suicide attempts among Veterans who have had cancer and recently completed treatment.
This project builds a software framework that lets many institutions train breast cancer risk models without sharing patient data.
This project studies how epigenetic regulation shapes the development of the dentate gyrus, a structure that is crucial for learning and memory.
This project builds statistical methods that combine gene knockout resources with omic data to work out what genes do and which genes may cause human phenotypes.
This project tests whether blocking a signaling pathway in bone marrow stromal cells can prevent or reduce bone loss that comes with age.
This project builds microscopes that image from subcellular dynamics up to entire model organisms and automatically adjust their own resolution.
This project tries to improve the health of oocytes made from stem cells by matching the developmental timing of germ cells and somatic cells.
This project builds informatics tools that collect, combine, and analyze data on how molecules oscillate with the day and night cycle.
This project uses data science, machine learning, and vascular physiology testing to find the factors behind cardiovascular complications during pregnancy.
This project studies how chromatin remodeling affects gene expression and DNA damage repair, and what happens to brain development when it is disrupted.
This project develops genome editing strategies to treat aortic aneurysm in Marfan syndrome.
